title: The Cutting Edge: Week of June 14th
body:
**Highlights**
- [Newsletter](https://www.getrevue.co/profile/joonian) for the Edgeware Treasury funded podcast series 'How to Make it in Crypto Media' is open for everyone to subscribe to. The [first text-based issue](https://www.getrevue.co/profile/joonian/issues/covering-the-crypto-media-boom-166154) is also now publicly available.
- Hybrid AMA with [PicoSwap](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1138-introducing-picoswap-and-pico) was a success despite being experimental. [Audible version of the AMA](https://t.me/heyedgeware/47001) is publicly available on telegram.
- [Edgeware subreddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/edgeware/) got a rejuvenating revamp.
- [Wako, the new stable release](https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-node/releases/tag/v3.3.1) of the Edgeware node is now available for node operators to upgrade. Once 80-90% of all node operators upgrade their node, the [ERUP-4 runtime upgrade](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1100-erup-4-substrate-30-evm-updates-runtime-modules) will be pushed to Edgeware's on-chain governance.


**Ecosystem Updates**
- Community members who are interested in running [Webb Protocol](https://www.webb.tools/)’s transaction relayers on Edgeware, please reach out to drew@webb.tools.


**Governance**
- The [treasury funding proposal by Joon Ian Wong and Pet Berisha](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/1135-how-to-make-it-in-crypto-media-an-original-podcast-series) for their ‘How to make it in Crypto Media - an Original Podcast Series’ was passed through Referendum 43 but didn’t execute as the proposeSpend function was used instead of approveProposal function. {Referendum type: SimpleMajorityApprove, Democracy Proposal ID: -, Treasury Proposal ID:34} The result of this referendum was treated as a public mandate to pass the same treasury proposal as a Council Motion #49.
